avoid_hooks: Jesus... my manager asked me to sign a report. The numbers in it are not true.
Jesus... I shouted at my brother tonight. And it was not my voice. It was my father's.
Jesus... I parked outside church this morning. I never went in. 😔
Jesus... everyone in my hostel went home for the holidays. I'm the only one left. 😔
Jesus... my friend asked me how I know You're real. Why couldn't I answer her?
Jesus... why do my parents only fight when they think I'm asleep? 😔
Jesus... I said yes again. I didn't want to. I never do. 😔
Jesus... my grandmother didn't know who I was today. She called me by my uncle's name. 😔
Jesus... why does it feel like my best friend has a whole new life without me?
Jesus... why does everyone in class understand except me?
Jesus... my last single friend got engaged today. I smiled in every photo. 😔
Jesus... why do I hate every photo of myself? My friend posted one tonight and I made her delete it. 😔
Jesus... why does my mind get loud the moment I lie down? It's 3 AM again. 😔
Jesus... I was the one who hurt her. It's been three years, and I never said sorry. 😔
